thread:
Alex (Product): quick sync — running through OKR milestones for this cycle. go/no-go for the roadmap items? what shipped, what slipped, and owner next steps. I’ll call out the three cross-team pieces: (1) model routing fallback, (2) deploy pipeline for dedicated, (3) billing/usage export.
Maya (Eng): I can start — model routing fallback: core logic merged, e2e tests failing intermittently, blocked by kv-cache race. PR: https://git.redwood/eng/4823 :eyes:
Sam (Backend): kv-cache race is on me. root cause is TTL race in shard reassign. have a small patch, running load test now. if green, will ship patch and flip fallback flag. ETA ~5h. :racehorse:
Oliver (Runtime): for routing perf, we measured 95th p50 stable, but p99 spikes on long sequences. I’ve got a mitigator (chunked-attn patch) that reduces spikes ~20% on local. need to coordinate with Sam for canary.
Priya (Infra): deploy pipeline for Dedicated — the infra terraform change landed but we discovered credential rotation step fails in prod account during integration. hit error: `403 KMSAccessDenied` when attempting resource_create. We need security team rotation window tomorrow 1–2p PT.
Jess (QA): billing/usage export tests flaked on timezone boundary — CSV rounding mismatch. I’ll open a test-only PR to normalize timezone handling. Will run full retention smoke overnight.
Ben (SRE): FYI observed error burst at 02:12 UTC yesterday tied to a rollout of model-variant v2b. I rolled back the rollout policy which brought error rate down. Root cause looks like model mismatch with compilation kernel on T4. Oliver, can you add a guard to skip that variant on T4?
Oliver (Runtime): yep adding guard + a compatibility matrix. patching now. Will also tag the model as `no-t4` in catalog.
Alex (Product): thanks — can each owner reply with short "status / blocker / next step / ETA" so I can update exec summary? keeping it micro.
Maya (Eng): status: merged in main but tests flaky. blocker: kv-cache race (Sam). next: wait for Sam patch + run e2e. ETA: EOD today if patch passes.
Sam (Backend): status: patch in review, load tests ongoing. blocker: none after patch; next: deploy to canary, monitor 12h. ETA: patch deploy in ~5h, canary by EOD.
Oliver (Runtime): status: mitigator branch built. blocker: need Sam canary to validate. next: integrate mitigator into canary, run perf harness. ETA: canary + perf by tomorrow morning.
Priya (Infra): status: terraform landed in staging. blocker: prod KMS rotation window. next: schedule rotation, re-run apply after window, then promote. ETA: rotation tomorrow 1–2p PT, promote by end of day tomorrow.
Jess (QA): status: test fixes in branch. blocker: none. next: run overnight smoke on retention. will post results. ETA: morning report.
Ben (SRE): status: rollback done. blocker: we need model gating on T4 (Oliver). next: monitor post-canary, prepare incident runbook update. ETA: runbook PR today.
Lina (ProdOps): for billing/usage export — status: schema change delayed because of timezone bug. blocker: QA verification. next: coordinated rollout after QA signoff, update docs. ETA: coordinated rollout by Thu EOD.
Alex (Product): action items summary: (A) Sam deploy patch -> canary (owner: Sam, ETA: ~5h), (B) Runtime mitigator into canary (owner: Oliver, ETA: tomorrow AM), (C) Prod KMS rotation (owner: Priya, ETA: tomorrow 1–2p PT), (D) Billing CSV normalization + QA (owner: Jess/Lina, ETA: Thu EOD), (E) Update runbook for model rollouts (owner: Ben, ETA: today). Please react with :white_check_mark: when you’ve read and will follow owner items.
Sam (Backend): :white_check_mark: will follow.
Oliver (Runtime): :white_check_mark:
Priya (Infra): :white_check_mark: scheduling rotation now.
Jess (QA): :white_check_mark: running overnight.
Ben (SRE): :white_check_mark: drafting runbook PR.
Lina (ProdOps): :white_check_mark: coordinating billing docs.
deploy-bot: Deployment event — canary pipeline triggered for infra/app 4823 by Sam at 1779003200. status: running.
Alex (Product): awesome — I’ll compile this into the weekly exec note and tag owners. If anything slips, ping here with updates. thanks all! :pray:
